title: Deadrot 3D model manifest
description: Curated manifest of 3D model masters in packages/assets/models: stable id, source/provenance, and one or more Git LFS-tracked GLB/glTF variants (static, animated, and later optimized runtime derivatives). Hand-edited; validated by scripts/check-models.mjs (deadrot.com#493). Consumed through the typed resolver in src/models.ts.

version.description: Format version of the manifest document.

cdnBase.description: Default CDN origin; overridable at runtime via ASSET_BASE_URL or an explicit baseUrl.

models.description: Every catalogued 3D model, one canonical entry per stable id.

id.description: Stable model id, addressable the same way sprite ids are.

entity.description: Canonical universe entity id this model renders (links to assets-catalog.json), where applicable.

pbr.description: Whether the model carries PBR materials.

faceCount.description: Approximate triangle/face budget of the master mesh.

provenance.description: How the model was produced and what it derives from.

defaultVariant.description: The `key` of the variant resolvers return when none is requested.

variants.description: The concrete GLB/glTF files for this model.

generatedAt.description: ISO date the master was generated (YYYY-MM-DD).

key.description: Variant selector, unique within a model (e.g. `static`, `animated`, `runtime`).

pose.description: Whether the variant carries animation channels.

optimization.description: `master` is the raw source-of-truth; `runtime` is a Draco/WebP-optimized derivative.

path.description: Safe package-relative path to the LFS-tracked file; dot segments and backslashes are forbidden.

bytes.description: File size in bytes (matches the LFS pointer `size`).

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the file contents (matches the LFS pointer `oid`).

derivedFrom.description: The `key` of the variant this one was derived from, if any.

tool.description: Tool that produced a derived variant.
